name: MKTG 5100
title: Business Fundamentals for Social Impact
description: This bootcamp course is an introduction to fundamental business concepts of interest to all business managers. Students learn terms, frameworks, and analytical tools relevant for interacting successfully with others in business organizations. Students gain experience using these elements to understand and integrate the desirability, feasibility, and viability of business models.
requirement_description: Open only to Social Responsibility and Impact in Business M.S. students, others with consent.
